name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Callisto goes with at least one of Okafor or Algae.
Fungus goes with at least one of Dasari, Okafor, or Callisto.
Luna goes with either Basalt or Geode.
Fontaine, Luna, and Algae belong to different colonists.
Regolith goes with either Fontaine or Callisto (but not both).
Fontaine goes with none of Earth, Basalt, or Regolith.
